searchText: As noted on the call, pinging this channel to ask for us to add some Teku nodes that are running our rust implementation for the cryptography. <@425907307621122049> added the option to enable this on the cli with the `--Xrust-kzg-enabled` flag PR for reference: https://github.com/Nashatyrev/teku/pull/62 does it make any sense to default to this going forward on all teku nodes? or would you prefer 1/2-1/2? Also does it make sense to do this on devnet 1 ? it looks dead currently, maybe if we recover by any chance I will try to add some fixes until it's closed Doubt we can recover. We had discussed during the call today that we gonna try to relaunch with the same spec later this week. (end of the week) will try to fix something before this 1/2 - 1/2 would be great (not sure there is a way for check when a teku node is using one versus the other) only way is to check overrides in the ansible values. we have one log line added, but no other difference also if you would inspect the container, you would see what flags are active Gonna try to find the 1/2 of 3, and deploy it on it lol are there any notes from today call? I missed it whats the expected log message we supposed to see? Loaded LibPeerDASKZG library rolled it out on teku-geth-3 ``` 2024-07-09 13:17:58.147 INFO - Loaded C-KZG-4844 library 2024-07-09 13:18:05.369 INFO - Loaded LibPeerDASKZG library ``` 👍 absolutely beautiful, now we have 8 different forks, till now teku was at least on the same fork, now they decided, not good enugh lol Peerdas introduces fork diversity Hey guys! Is there a way to check peerIDs of the clients in devnet? Well, <@425907307621122049> has shown IPs already 👍 https://bootnode-1.peerdas-devnet-1.ethpandaops.io/meta/api/v1/inventory.json
